label: step-008
payload: Now run 'rename_inv.py' by executing it through the context-mode MCP sandbox (the ctx_execute / ctx_batch_execute tool), NOT the Bash tool, to apply all of its renames to 'inventory.py' and its test file. Important: perform the rename by running that script through the MCP sandbox — do NOT use your Edit/Write tools to change 'inventory.py' or its test file directly.
